tools.name: forge
tools.description: One-shot end-to-end resume engineering pipeline (repo fact mining -> template matching -> HTML canvas -> Dual QA -> A4 PDF).

tools.name: extract_evidence
tools.description: Mine codebase and Git commit history for verified L1~L3 technical facts and architecture signals.

tools.name: search_template
tools.description: Search and rank HTML resume templates based on target role, style, target page count, and information density.

tools.name: analyze_jd
tools.description: Analyze raw Job Description (JD) text to extract must-have skills, nice-to-have skills, seniority, and hiring signals.

tools.name: instantiate_resume
tools.description: Instantiate a self-contained intermediate HTML working canvas (workspace/resume.html) from a chosen template with keyword highlights and candidate data.

tools.name: validate_resume
tools.description: Run automated layout, Design Tokens, semantic structure, and text density checks on the intermediate HTML canvas.

tools.name: render_pdf
tools.description: Render deterministic vector A4 PDF using multi-strategy auto-discovery browser engine.
